_comment: 🧩️ This plugin's contribution to the repository test platform, discovered by convention (`testContributionDirName` in 🔣️taxonomy.json). It carries NO oracle and NO catalog: every mutation vocabulary and inference this plugin owns belongs to ONE subset of ONE standard of ONE artifact (`🏢️model`), so that subset registers its own oracle decisions and catalogs in its own 🔣️oracle.json. What lives here is the single thing a subset manifest cannot express — the host packages this plugin's test adapters link — because `oracleHostPackagesFor` resolves host packages from the nearest contributor AT OR ABOVE the case owner, and a case owner is an artifact root, never a subset.
